subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding request — Nimble Partners
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan@nimblepartners.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: invoice-only onboarding + PO flexibility

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Nimble Partners is excited to move from trial to paid. Our procurement team requires invoicing rather than issuing purchase orders for third-party SaaS in our vendor catalog. Before we start, can Redwood support an invoice-only onboarding path (no PO) for the initial 60–90 day period while we finish our vendor setup?

We can provide W-9, signed SOW, and references immediately. The ask is temporary: once our internal vendor record is complete we can switch to a standard PO-based flow.

Can you confirm what evidence you need and whether a short-term exception is possible?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Mills
Head of Ops, Nimble Partners
procurement@nimblepartners.com
Attachments: NimblePartners_W9.pdf (application/pdf), NimblePartners_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan@nimblepartners.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only onboarding + PO flexibility

Hi Jordan — great to hear. Vivek looping in procurement/finance to confirm operational controls. Quick summary of what we typically require when a customer requests a temporary invoice-only path:

- Completed vendor intake (basic vendor questionnaire)
- W-9 / tax form (you attached — thanks)
- Signed SOW or contract (attached — thanks)
- Bank or ACH details submitted via secure transfer (we provide a link)
- Agreed limits (cap on spend) and payment terms (Net 30/45) for the trial period

If you can send the questionnaire (I’ll paste the secure intake link below) we’ll route to procurement for a risk review. Our standard policy is PO-first, but we do temporary invoice-only exceptions for enterprise trials when finance signs off. Proposal: 60–90 day invoice-only pilot, cap of $50k and Net 45, subject to monthly reconciliation.

Link to vendor intake (secure): https://redwood-secure.intake/vendor

Putting Vivek and our procurement lead on this thread to lock details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Jordan

Looping in finance (Lauren) for approval. Thanks @Marissa for the proposed terms. A few procurement notes before we grant a temporary exception:

- Risk score: preliminary looks low/medium based on company age and references; still need bank verification.

Approved with conditions — see below.

Decision summary:
- Approved: Temporary invoice-only onboarding for Nimble Partners for 60 days from first invoice date.
- Cap: $50,000 total liability during the period.
- Terms: Net 45 payment terms.
- Controls: Monthly reconciliation required; invoices to be sent to ap@redwood.com and flagged "Nimble-temp-allowlist".
- Evidence: Signed allowlist via DocuSign prior to first invoice; bank details submitted via our secure portal; final vendor questionnaire on file.

I have uploaded the temporary allowlist (nimble_temp_allowlist_form.pdf) to HubSpot and generated a DocuSign template for signature. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-4592 — please attach signed DocuSign envelope to the deal record.

Jordan — please e-sign the allowlist here (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/templates/NIMBLE-ALLOWLIST-2026 and submit bank details at: https://redwood-secure.intake/vendor/bank. Once signed and bank info is received we’ll enable invoice-only billing for the window above.

Lauren Bishop
